facebook.caption:
47,218 reviews. One small island. One of Hanoi's oldest Buddhist temples still standing.

Tran Quoc Pagoda sits on West Lake, surrounded by water on all sides. The kind of place that stops you mid-scroll for a reason. Multiple shrines, lotus ponds, a 15-meter Bodhi tree grown from a cutting of the original in India.

Phu Quoc Tips usually covers the island, but this one deserves a detour if you're passing through Hanoi first.

Save this for your Vietnam trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walking the island path around Tran Quoc Pagoda, West Lake on every side. Smoke from incense, orange robes, stone stupas. This is Hanoi at full volume, then silence.
